policy: Discrepancies are reported. Ground-truth labels already present on the original 13 first-batch samples were not rewritten.

findings.summary: atomic/first20_fixtures.json was truncated after 13 objects and was invalid JSON. 19 raw files existed. Six NOAA/NAVCEN files had no manifests. There was no 20th body.
findings.action: Rebuilt the batch index and materialized per-sample manifests. Original 13 label fields copied unchanged. Six new provisional labels added from retained bytes.

findings.summary: manifest.json and corpus_manifest.json reported 0 collected while raw bodies existed.
findings.action: Counts now derived from collected manifests and retained files. Still far below 420.

findings.summary: ATOM-USGS-01 observed_at=2026-06-25T10:54:32Z is USGS properties.updated, not origin time. published_at/effective_at correctly use origin 2024-04-02T23:58:12Z. Label unchanged.
findings.action: Documented only. New USGS samples map origin time to published_at/effective_at/observed_at.

findings.summary: Repository 28 scenarios are not the same 28 listed in the implementation handoff. Missing from repo: Taiwan military exercises (+ negative), LA/LB congestion negative, Ever Given/Suez (+ negative), Vancouver flood (+ negative), Yantian congestion, Shanghai lockdown, Maersk cyberattack. Present instead: FAA, 511, customs hold, sanctions name-match, port reopening, geopolitical news, wildfire, NAVCEN, inventory stockout, prompt-injection, conflict.
findings.action: Kept repository 28 as the established scaffold. Did not replace scenario IDs.

findings.summary: scoring/gates.json omits several handoff hard gates (schema-valid 99%/99.9%, material recall 95%, precision 90%, critical-event recall 98%, entity F1, port F1, grounding 99%, exposure recall/precision 95%, geographic correlation 97%). zh-TW recall 0.93 is present. Quality geographic matching is 0.95 not 0.97.
findings.action: Did not silently rewrite gates.json. Bakeoff harness computes the missing metrics so they can be added in a reviewed scoring revision.

findings.summary: Scenario expected.exposures use types such as departure_delay, monitor_only, quarantine_untrusted_instruction. Canonical Exposure types are delay, capacity_loss, inventory_stockout, customer_commitment, financial, compliance, route_disruption.
findings.action: Documented. Scenario expected blocks left unchanged.

findings.summary: Contract exists as DOCX. JSON schemas existed only for Evidence (thin), atomic samples, scenarios, and benchmark manifest. ExternalEvent JSON schema was added additively.
findings.action: Do not treat DOCX tables as silently redefined.

findings.summary: LNM PDF Title metadata is Delay_Report_11-2017.pdf because that form is an enclosure. Page 1 text is District 11 LNM week 12/24 and 33/24.
findings.action: Manifest notes record the enclosure. Labels based on page-1 identity.

findings.summary: ATOM-FAA-NAS-SNAPSHOT retained bytes are the NAS status SPA shell, not airport rows. ATOM-FAA-NAS-XML holds the structured XML feed snapshot.
findings.action: Documented on the HTML sample. XML sample added.

findings.summary: Wave-2 sample ATOM-USGS-HUALIEN-M5-B retained body is M 5.1 Hinatuan, Philippines. Initial collector note called it Hualien.
findings.action: Corrected labels to irrelevant to match retained geography. Sample ID left as assigned.
